verdict.rationale: SerpApi ships an official MCP server (github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp) that lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) use it as a web-search tool out of the box. Community discussion confirms the MCP server is in real use and supports Bearer-token auth on the /mcp path. LLM-optimized markdown output and an llms.txt further suit direct tool-call consumption. missing for 10: explicit function-calling/tool JSON schemas (OpenAPI probes all 404), documented integrations with agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call quality.
